title: fresh load-only receipt
expectation: exact current message appended + flushed, durable readback, no generation, receipt only after all of it
actual: receipt at exact seq=1, 3 flushes, zero followup/model calls, agent disposed

title: long history resume baseline
expectation: same Session resumes 3000 persisted events; the resume suffix and the fixed title append are bound into the baseline before the exact load message
actual: same Session shiyu-replyer-verify-load-long-0001: 3000 prefix events preserved, suffix ["session/end-seed","session/title","user/message"], receipt seq=3002

title: foreign append during authorize(append)
expectation: a foreign user/message written to the same Session while authorize(append) awaits must not be acknowledged; no durable receipt, no deletion
actual: foreign append left in the log (403 events), no receipt/ack; load failed with "Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix"

title: foreign append during authorize(context_ack)
expectation: a foreign write landing before the acknowledgement callback must prevent onContextDurable
actual: foreign event preserved in the log, no durable receipt and no load result

title: pending inbox blocks load
expectation: unknown pending input is never removed to make loading succeed; no receipt and the input is preserved
actual: load refused with "Pending native inbox blocks load-only context"; pending input preserved

title: flush failure before receipt
expectation: if the durability barrier for the loaded message does not confirm, no load receipt escapes even though the in-memory append happened
actual: load refused with "Native Session durability listener did not handle the flush"; no receipt

title: deadline during authorize
expectation: an absolute deadline exceeded while authorize(append) awaits rejects without a receipt
actual: deadline observed during authorize(append); load refused without receipt

title: same Session second load
expectation: the same business Session id is resumed, the first loaded message remains native history, and the second exact message extends it
actual: one created + one resumed Session shiyu-replyer-89274b5b-c1a4-45d9-a0e8-472d3811706a, both exact messages retained, second receipt seq=3

title: cancel during authorize
expectation: cooperative cancellation rejects without a load receipt and the owned Agent is released
actual: cancellation observed; no receipt, agent released

title: existing fixed title
expectation: a Session whose title is already user-pinned needs no title write; seq is not assumed to change and the load still produces an exact receipt
actual: no duplicate title append; suffix ["session/title","session/end-seed","user/message"]; receipt seq=222

title: foreign inbox during authorize
expectation: an unregistered pending input arriving over the live Session during the append authorization blocks the acknowledgement and is preserved
actual: load refused with "Load-only context failed and native cleanup could not be confirmed"; pending input preserved, no receipt

title: adapter restart recovery
expectation: after closing the adapter, a new adapter instance with the persisted binding resumes the same native Session (no replacement Session) and still issues an exact receipt
actual: restarted adapter resumed shiyu-replyer-cff147fc-25c8-4fcb-b0a3-9a283274fb30 without a replacement Session; prefix preserved; receipt seq=3

title: independent durable readback
expectation: the acknowledged seq/type/full-message hash read back through a fresh independent handle equals what the log holds; the receipt is never just the adapter success field
actual: exact message read back at seq=1802 through a fresh independent handle (1803 events)
